Made in Bristol

Crafted in our Bristol workshop

Every piece that leaves Konk is built by the same small team, in one workshop, from solid oak and walnut. We work the timber ourselves — cut it, joint it, sand it and finish it by hand — and we don't subcontract or batch-build.

It's slower than buying off a warehouse shelf. That's the point: furniture made this way is meant to live in your home for decades, not seasons.

  • Solid oak and walnut throughout — never veneer over chipboard
  • Traditional joinery: mortise-and-tenon legs, dovetailed drawers
  • Hand-applied oil finish you can re-oil at home, not a sprayed lacquer
  • Built by one small team in Bristol, not on a production line

Before you buy

Frequently asked

How long does it take?

Most pieces are built and dispatched in around 6–8 weeks. We confirm an exact dispatch window in writing before we take payment, so you always know where you are.

Do you make custom sizes?

Yes — everything is made to order, so a custom length, width or height is straightforward. Send us your measurements and we'll quote it. The price scales with the timber, not a custom-fee surcharge.

How much is delivery?

Free across mainland UK. Our two-person team delivers fully assembled, brings the piece into the room of your choice and takes the packaging away with them.

Where are you based?

Our workshop is in Bristol — everything we sell is designed, built and finished there by our own team. Nothing is outsourced.

Can I see pieces in person?

Yes — get in touch and we'll arrange a workshop visit. It's a good way to see the timber, joinery and finishes up close before you commit.

Good to know

Questions, answered

How long does it take?

Most Signature tables ship around 6–8 weeks from order. We confirm the exact dispatch window in writing before we take payment, so there are no surprises.

Can I order a custom size?

Yes — every table is built to order, so a custom length, width or height is straightforward. Send us your measurements and we'll quote it; the price scales with the timber, not a custom-fee surcharge.

How is it delivered?

Delivered fully assembled by our two-person team across mainland UK, free of charge. They'll bring it into the room of your choice and take the packaging away. We'll book a date that works once your piece is finished.

How do I care for it?

Wipe with a soft, slightly damp cloth — no harsh cleaners. The hand-applied oil finish can be refreshed at home once a year with the care kit we include, which keeps the wood looking and feeling its best for the long run.

What's your returns policy?

Standard sizes can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund — we'll arrange collection. Fully custom builds are made to your exact spec, so they're non-returnable unless faulty; everything is covered by our craftsmanship guarantee.
